purpose: Which native scientific driver each role uses. Results are only comparable with the driver they were produced on.

v1.known_weakness: Merges submitted minima on client-reported energies: fabricated minima claiming low energies can evict honest ones before refinement (protocol amendment 6, I-c).

v2.change: Every minimum read from a submitted pool is rescored from its conformation (energy and heavy-atom coordinates) before merge selection; client-reported values never influence selection.

verification.falsified_energy_attack_mean_delta_auc: v1: means as low as -0.034. v2: means within +/-0.0016 at every fraction; 95% intervals within +/-0.004 at f<=0.25 and +/-0.009 at f=0.75, the same as honest duplication.
verification.overhead_note: Measured while G1/G2 crystal docking loaded the machine; per-state differences ranged -196 to +265 ms.

v2.status: verified; not yet serving production traffic

rule: New campaigns and any production finalizer use v2. Reproducing an earlier result uses v1. Never mix outputs from the two in one comparison.
